subject: general
question: The Intensive Agriculture District Programme (IADP) was launched as the first major experiment in intensive agriculture development in the year __________.
solution:
The correct answer is**__1960.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The accelerated** Agriculture District Programme (IADP) **was begun as the first major observation in intensive agriculture development in the year 1960.
 
• It had covered all the important cash crops grown in the districts although attention was to be laid on the dominant food **- grain crops such as paddy, wheat and millets.**
 
• The main thought behind the IADP was that increased agricultural yield shall** lead to economic growth,** which shall carry welfare to the society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The intensive Agriculture Development program was initiated with the benefit of the Ford Foundation. It was begun as a pilot basis in one district of 7 states at that time.
 
• The IADP generally known as** the package program was begun in three districts in 1960 - 61** and in four districts in 1962 - 63. **The seven districts were:**
 
 
• **Thanjavur (Tamil Nadu)**
 
• **West Godavari (Andhra Pradesh)**
 
• **Shahabad (Bihar)**
 
• **Raipur (Madhya Pradesh)**
 
• **Aligarh (Uttar Pradesh)**
 
• **Ludhiana (Punjab)**
 
• **Pali (Rajasthan) **
